mapper.select: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, PARA_CODE, PARA_VALUE, CONFIG_DATE FROM STL_SEC_RECON_PARA T1 WHERE PARA_CODE = #{RECON_PARA_CODE_02}

SELECT to_date(T1.SJRQ,'yyyyMMdd') cdate, T1.QMYE zybs, CASE WHEN T1.BZ in ('0', '人民币') THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZ in ('1', '港币') THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZ in ('2', '美元') THEN 'USD' END jylb, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM INTERF_ZX_ZJYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH WHERE T1.SJRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT TO_DATE(T1.JYRQ, 'yyyyMMdd') cdate, T1.ZJYE zybs, CASE WHEN T1.BZLB in ('RMB', '人民币') THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('HKD', '港币') THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('USD', '美元') THEN 'USD' END jylb, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM INTERF_ZJYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH WHERE T1.JYRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT to_date(T1.SJRQ,'yyyyMMdd') cdate, sum(T1.CCSL) amout, T1.ZQZH acctNo, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END marketId, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, NVL(T3.CCY,'CNY') jylb FROM INTERF_ZX_GFYE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T1.ZQDM || '.' || DECODE(T1.JYSC, '0', 'SZ', '深圳', 'SZ', '1', 'SH', '上海', 'SH') AND T3.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F32' WHERE T1.SJRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.JYSC IN ('0', '1', '深圳', '上海') group by T1.SJRQ, T1.ZQZH, T1.ZQDM,T3.FINPROD_ID,T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T3.CCY UNION ALL SELECT to_date(T1.JYRQ,'yyyyMMdd') cdate, sum(T1.DQYE) amout, T1.ZQZH acctNo, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END marketId, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, CASE WHEN T1.BZLB in ('RMB', '人民币') THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('HKD', '港币') THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('USD', '美元') THEN 'USD' END jylb FROM INTERF_CCYE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T1.ZQDM || '.' || DECODE(T1.JYLB, '2', 'SZ', '深圳', 'SZ', '1', 'SH', '上海', 'SH') AND T3.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F32' WHERE T1.JYRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by T1.JYRQ, T1.ZQZH, T1.ZQDM,T3.FINPROD_ID,T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.BZLB

SELECT INSTRUCTION_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEAT_NUMBER, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, MARKET_ID, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_DATE, ACCOUT, SEC_ACCT_ID, CCY, sum(TRADE_NUM) TRADE_NUM, SUM(TRADE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, SUM(INT_AMT) INT_AMT, SUM(HGDQJE) HGDQJE, SUM(STAMP_FEE) STAMP_FEE, SUM(JSF_AMT) JSF_AMT , SUM(GHF_AMT) GHF_AMT, SUM(ZGF_AMT) ZGF_AMT, SUM(SETTLE_FEE) SETTLE_FEE, SUM(TRADE_FEE) TRADE_FEE, SUM(COMMISSION_AMT) COMMISSION_AMT, SUM(OTHER_FEEAMT) OTHER_FEEAMT, SUM(TOTAL_TEEAMT) TOTAL_TEEAMT FROM (
) resultData GROUP BY INSTRUCTION_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEAT_NUMBER, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, MARKET_ID, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_DATE, ACCOUT, SEC_ACCT_ID, CCY

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SEAT_NUMBER, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, MARKET_ID, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_DATE, ACCOUT, SEC_ACCT_ID, CCY, SUM(TRADE_NUM) TRADE_NUM, SUM(TRADE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, SUM(INT_AMT) INT_AMT, SUM(HGDQJE) HGDQJE, SUM(STAMP_FEE) STAMP_FEE, SUM(JSF_AMT) JSF_AMT , SUM(GHF_AMT) GHF_AMT, SUM(ZGF_AMT) ZGF_AMT, SUM(SETTLE_FEE) SETTLE_FEE, SUM(TRADE_FEE) TRADE_FEE, SUM(COMMISSION_AMT) COMMISSION_AMT, SUM(OTHER_FEEAMT) OTHER_FEEAMT, SUM(TOTAL_TEEAMT) TOTAL_TEEAMT FROM (
) resultData GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, SEAT_NUMBER, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, MARKET_ID, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_DATE, ACCOUT, SEC_ACCT_ID, CCY
